audit.basis: Vue 3 fragment roots are accepted. DirectiveObjectArg has three meaningful roots, so no single-root-v-if warning; the other originals have no root v-if.
All four filenames have at least two uppercase letters. RouterView is PascalCase and is a value import used by the template; component is a builtin dynamic tag with :is.
RouterView has one unargumented component-default v-slot, the default permitted style. Its sole Component binding is consumed by :is, without v-for shadowing or conflicting child slots.

Every p has nonempty text/interpolation content, normal-HTML closing policy is Any, RouterView has children and dynamic component is self-closing. All delimiters have whitespace, all attribute outer quotes are double, each opening has at most one directive, and multiline indentation is not a same-line multi-space gap.

The title expressions interpolate x, rather than constant strings; title and is do not match their expression identifiers. Interpolations are calls/conditionals, not bare string literals; no boolean attributes occur.

Each original has nonempty script setup lang=ts followed by a nonempty plain template, no styles/src/custom blocks, and an accepted script/template order. CSS preset members therefore have no source owner.
The d73 require-vapor-attribute callback is an explicitly empty placeholder, not a hidden requirement to rewrite originals. No inline-template or dynamic class occurs.
No landmark/form/interactive/media/list roles, events, IDs, URL attributes, browser globals or nondeterministic expressions occur. Native content consists only of p, plus RouterView/component.

Setup scripts define typed functions and primitive constants, or import RouterView from vue-router. They contain no options export/defineComponent, compiler/reserved/import internals, macros/ref/computed/watch/nextTick, forwarding attrs, slot function calls, unstable nested component or props/emits default ownership.

There are no props/emits declarations or reactive destructuring. isA/isPositive return boolean and t returns string; all template calls are synchronous. Template literals yield string and complete ternaries yield string. RouterView Component has its genuine resolved slot type; its pattern declares a binding rather than producing a value query. No missing-runtime/import diagnostic is suppressed.
